claims.claim: Azure guidance clearly separates Meta Harness MCP, remote MCP gateway design, Azure Foundry Agent Service, Azure MCP Server, model provider configuration, and Azure hosting substrate.
Remote MCP guidance includes authentication, Origin validation, tool allowlists, approval policy, audit logging, redaction/retention, network review, and read-only defaults.
The CLI rejects unknown MCP modes before server startup while preserving read-only default behavior.

Live Azure deployment, Azure MCP Server invocation, Foundry-to-Meta-Harness runtime connection, and remote Meta Harness MCP hosting remain not verified because Phase 7 intentionally did not provision or mutate cloud resources.
Phase 7 local validation completed across install, clean, CI, docs build, production audit, package dry-runs, schema check, budget, doctor, formatting, diff hygiene, and tarball cleanup checks.
Independent reviewer found Phase 7 aligned, on track, strong evidence quality, no blockers, no recovery slices, and recommended continuation.
